rules.warning: Promotion code creation sends the coupon as promotion: { type: 'coupon', coupon }. Promotion codes no longer expand promotion.coupon in responses; reads of the Coupon object need an expand or coupons.retrieve.
rules.quote: You should now reference [Coupons](https://docs.stripe.com/api/coupons/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) from [Promotion Codes](https://docs.stripe.com/api/promotion_codes/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) using the new [promotion.coupon](https://docs.stripe.com/api/promotion_codes/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover#promotion_code_object-promotion-coupon) parameter, and specify the [promotion.type](https://docs.stripe.com/api/promotion_codes/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover#promotion_code_object-promotion-type) parameter as `coupon`.
rules.benchmark: Reproduces the reviewed hand-written pack rule with identical behaviour; refit-bench comparison against main 5ba25c1e in docs/BENCHMARKS.md (generated rules, 2026-10-27).

rules.warning: Coupon IDs of promotion codes and discounts are read through a generated helper: the old coupon.id when present (old-version events), otherwise promotion.coupon or source.coupon when its type is coupon, an ID unless expanded. A missing coupon reads as undefined. Webhook endpoints are not changed.
rules.quote: This change adds a new [source](https://docs.stripe.com/api/discounts/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover#discount_object-source) property to the [Discount](https://docs.stripe.com/api/discounts/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.clover) object and removes the auto-expanded `coupon` property.
